name: Tamoxifen
mechanism: Competitive ER antagonist in breast tissue with partial agonist activity in endometrium, bone and liver. A prodrug converted mainly by CYP2D6 to active metabolites, including endoxifen.
monitoring: Prompt gynaecological evaluation of abnormal vaginal bleeding
interactions: Strong CYP2D6 inhibitors (e.g. paroxetine, fluoxetine, bupropion) may reduce active metabolite formation and should be avoided. Potentiates warfarin; monitor INR.
resistance: ESR1 mutations (some), growth factor receptor crosstalk and altered coregulator expression.
